verdict.rationale: Lithic documents this use case by name: its agentic-payments blog describes creating a virtual card for an agent and configuring Authorization Rules on merchant categories, transaction limits and velocity. Its agentic-commerce page also positions issuing and controls for AI workflows, and card-level Auth Rules on MCC/country plus card spend limits supply the scoping. Missing for 10: no evidence of card expiry or time-boxed cards, merchant locking is shown only as MCC/category rules rather than a specific-merchant lock, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
